Method of Attack: Malspam campaign delivering malicious PDF receipts that prompt users with a fake captcha
PDF downloads a malicious Word document with macros
Malicious macro launches PowerShell command to download and execute a PowerShell script
PowerShell script decodes and launches GandCrab ransomware executable
Ransomware connects to remote Command & Control servers and encrypts victim's computer
Attack Vector: Email malspam with PDF attachments containing malicious payloads
